title: Return named data
summary: Spring Boot: Return named data. Add another field.
introduction: Spring Boot writes a Map as JSON. Open GET /book. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Return named data with Spring Boot

blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save one example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. JBang downloads the dependency on the //DEPS line. Use http://127.0.0.1:8080 and stop the server before another example.

blocks.title: Return named data

blocks.text: The Map key title becomes a JSON field with value Moon Trip.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: JSON object field order is not part of its meaning.
